title: senro event
description: One entry in a run's append-only ledger (events.jsonl). Routing fields are flat; the type-specific body is nested under payload. The envelope is OPEN: additionalProperties is true because events are persisted and re-read by arbitrary later readers, and a newer engine may add envelope fields within the same major version. Consumers MUST ignore unknown envelope fields, unknown type values, and unknown payload fields: treating any of them as an error breaks forward compatibility.

v.description: Envelope version. Major must match between client and engine.

seq.description: Monotonically increasing sequence number within the run.

type.description: Event type. The enum below is informative, not exhaustive: newer engines emit types absent from this list and clients must ignore them.

step.description: Stable base step ID. Never carries an attempt suffix; see attempt.

attempt.description: Attempt number, 1-based. Absent or 0 when the event is not step-scoped.

group.description: Expansion parent, so clients can aggregate without knowing the plan structure.

trace_id.description: The W3C Trace Context trace this run belongs to: 16 bytes as 32 lowercase hex characters, never the all-zero value, identical on every event of the run and different for every run. Taken from an inbound traceparent when there was a valid one, and freshly generated otherwise. Absent on events written by builds older than protocol v1.1. The span structure lives in the payloads: run.started carries span_id, parent_span_id, trace_flags and tracestate; step.started and step.finished carry span_id, parent_span_id and linked_span_ids.

payload.description: Type-specific body. Unknown fields MUST be ignored.
